name: France

wildFacts.text: First-round turnout of 66.7% was the highest for a parliamentary first round since 1997.
To be elected in round one, a candidate needs an absolute majority of votes cast and at least a quarter of registered voters.

notes: Rounds 30 Jun and 7 Jul 2024 (date = second round). Seat counts per IPU; Interior Ministry classifies the left as Union de la gauche 178 (IPU note 1). RN holds 143 with allies; LR 66 with allies. Turnout 66.7% (32,910,888 of 49,332,761) per IPU. Voting is not compulsory for the National Assembly (International IDEA: https://www.idea.int/data-tools/data/voter-turnout-database/compulsory-voting). IDEA lists France as compulsory for Senate (indirect electors) only. No overall winner: hung parliament, with the NFP the largest bloc (180 of 577 seats, IPU) but short of a majority.
